title: Your weekly report writes itself
narration: This restaurant owner stopped writing Monday reports. Here is why.
Raw sales data. Just numbers. Nobody has time to read this.
One command. The math is computed locally, so the numbers are exact.
The AI only writes the analysis. Look. Tuesday is dead. The salmon is not selling.
It ends with three actions to try this week, tied to the data.
The script is linked below, free.
